correctness.rationale: Verified unique delta root between c² and 1 and b²-a²=ac sqrt(n). The John inclusion is the concave quadratic q(s)=(c+as)²+b²(1-s²), maximized only at s=1/sqrt(n); normalized contacts admit an exact isotropic finite frame, proving global John optimality. For Loewner, t=(1-c)v gives normalized quadratic ≤1-2c*v*(1-v)/(1+c), so only v=0,1 contact, with normalized ±coordinate tips providing the global Loewner frame. Limits follow by expanding the delta root. Independent sympy and sampled analytic parameter identities confirmed critical algebra, not the infinite statement. The c=0 ball is handled separately; c=1 excluded.
